notes.title: Remastered Soundtrack Update
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10140035/9da8d064a0c45e0eb75fb5e31ce540f54427444e.jpg

The Official Soundtrack DLC has now been updated with the new remastered version. All the game's songs, now reworked and remastered to perfection by the Seycara Music and Arts Orchestra.

Download the new remastered soundtrack today if you haven't already!
